demos.q: Is http://paytm-kyc-update.xyz/login safe? I got an SMS asking for my OTP
demos.answer: Authenticator apps and hardware security keys are stronger than SMS OTP because SIM-swap attacks can intercept SMS codes. [password_mfa.md] Phishing is a social-engineering attack where an attacker impersonates a trusted entity such as a bank, courier or government office to trick a victim into revealing credentials, OTPs or payment details. [phishing.md] Common signs: urgent language, mismatched sender domain, misspelled brand names in the URL, shortened links, requests for OTP or password, and unexpected attachments. [phishing.md] URL check for paytm-kyc-update.xyz: HIGH risk (high-abuse top-level domain; many hyphens in domain; brand name 'paytm' used on unofficial domain; no HTTPS).

demos.q: I got a call saying I am under digital arrest, what do I do?
demos.answer: "Digital arrest" scams threaten victims with fake legal action and demand money transfers. [social_engineering.md] No genuine agency conducts arrests or investigations over video call or demands payment to clear a case. [social_engineering.md] If defrauded, immediately call the bank, block cards and UPI, and file a complaint on the national cybercrime helpline 1930 or cybercrime.gov.in as soon as possible because early reporting improves the chance of freezing funds.
